recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7550 unless Patient Care opens a new issue to change the broader AllergyIntolerance negation model.
issue_request: FHIR-7550 was Published with Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core AllergyIntolerance. It requested explicit negation support by revising the AllergyIntolerance code value set to include concepts such as no known allergies/no known food allergies and adding a Negated Allergies and Intolerances guidance section, including refuting an obsolete negation statement when a new allergy is discovered.
initial_application: The original application is visible in old source history: commit 0eea1114d50dfb349fa07d20c74b64aba76bb94c mentions #7055/7550 and added the negation usage notes and value-set changes, and commit aead4b335ae5ba2e58976fab61fa02950003d793 mentions #7550 and added the refuted-negation note. Later source refactors renamed AllergyIntolerance.substance to AllergyIntolerance.code and reorganized generated/source artifacts, but the substance of the guidance remains.
additional_context: FHIR-7055 paired the seed with List guidance for No Known Allergies. FHIR-10358 renamed substance to code, added substanceExposureRisk, and updated the value set/documentation. FHIR-10380 cleaned up the documentation and value set name. FHIR-10442 corrected the no-known-allergy hierarchy to active SNOMED CT 716186003. FHIR-13087 added NKA/NKDA/No Known Latex Allergy examples. FHIR-26410 clarified that the preferred no-known-allergies wording means using AllergyIntolerance.code and added the inline NKA example. FHIR-35848 later confirmed the broad AllergyIntolerance.code semantics for conditions and statements, including negated statements. Community searches found no direct conflict with leaving the current source unchanged.
reconciliation: No source change was made. AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini; valueset-allergyintolerance-code.xml is titled/described for substance/product, condition, and negation codes and includes the SNOMED CT no-known-allergy hierarchy; allergyintolerance-notes.xml contains the Negated Allergies and Intolerances section, AllergyIntolerance.code versus List.emptyReason guidance, substanceExposureRisk note, and refuted-negation instruction; structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml defines code as supporting positive or negated/excluded statements and notes clinicalStatus should be present when the code is not negated.

related_jiras.note: Paired DSTU1 issue asking how List should fit into No Known Allergies guidance; its resolution explicitly expanded the section agreed to by FHIR-7550.
Renamed AllergyIntolerance.substance to AllergyIntolerance.code and updated the code value set/documentation while preserving negation support.
Cleaned AllergyIntolerance documentation and renamed the value set to reflect substance/product, condition, and negation codes.
Replaced the inactive no-known-allergy SNOMED ancestor with active 716186003 in the value set.
Added NKA, NKDA, and No Known Latex Allergy examples using AllergyIntolerance.code.
Clarified that the preferred no-known-allergies guidance means use AllergyIntolerance.code and added an inline NKA example.
Later no-change decision confirmed that AllergyIntolerance.code intentionally supports conditions and positive or negated statements.
